description: Consent revocation invalidates current admission decisions for registered invite, call, presence and MIMI consumers; any-scope invalidation preserves independent grants, current revisions never roll back, excluded private discovery and PSI stay unavailable, and requester outcomes remain opaque.

decision_points.requirement: Excluded private-contact discovery and PSI cannot be called or advertised and cannot change any index; MIMI identifier commitments cannot produce matches.
The next holder invite delivery re-evaluates current Consent before its durable CAS and never trusts a pre-revoke decision; a refusal remains opaque to the requester.
Revoking the independent any Consent invalidates every derived concrete-scope cache at the admission boundary without revoking other independent grants.
Older reads and exact Event retries never roll back the current Consent revision or reactivate a revoked grant.
Invite requester responses cannot distinguish a revoked Consent from one never granted, including in-flight revocation races.

cases.name: excluded_private_discovery_and_psi_remain_unavailable
cases.given: current-v1 offers only public Realm metadata discovery, and a peer has active or revoked Consent
cases.action: inspect advertised operations, attempt excluded discovery and PSI paths, and query the registered MIMI identifier facade
cases.observed: operation availability, MIMI match fields and index state
assertions: excluded discovery and PSI operations cannot be called or advertised
the attempts change no index and never invoke a PSI rotation
the authenticated MIMI facade returns matched=false without peer identity or handoff material for every commitment

cases.name: cached_invite_gate_is_reevaluated_before_the_next_submission
cases.given: an active Consent permitted a holder invite delivery preflight
cases.action: commit a matching revoke before the private delivery CAS, then retry the delivery
cases.observed: the holder delivery state and opaque requester response
assertions: no stale preflight authorizes the holder-private delivery CAS
the gate uses current Consent under the same holder PCR lock as Grant/Revoke
the requester receives opaque deferred without a consent_revoked reason

cases.name: an_any_scope_revoke_clears_every_scope_cache
cases.given: invite, call and presence decisions derive from one active any Consent, and another concrete grant is independent
cases.action: revoke the any consent_id with its exact expected_revision
cases.observed: each scope cache after the revoke
assertions: all decisions derived from that any Consent are invalidated at their actual admission boundaries
no registered consumer continues using a decision derived from the revoked any record
the independent concrete grant retains its current revision and remains eligible under its own scope and window

cases.name: older_reads_and_exact_retries_never_rollback_current_revision
cases.given: a grant was accepted and then revoked at a later holder PCR Commit
cases.action: replay the exact grant and revoke Events and deliver an older cached current read
cases.observed: historical retry outcomes and the subsequent authoritative current read
assertions: exact retries return their original accepted outcome without a new Commit
the current Consent remains revoked at the revoke revision
older cached reads cannot override a known revoke or authorize any consumer

cases.name: revocation_is_not_distinguishable_from_never_matching
cases.given: one peer had Consent revoked and another never received Consent
cases.action: attempt equivalent invite deliveries, including one preflight that races the revoke
cases.observed: the external response shape and timing for both peers
assertions: both requester responses have the same opaque deferred shape and disclosure class
consent_revoked is an internal authorization outcome and MUST NOT be the reason the requester sees
timing does not separate the two
